title: TaskRecord
description: Design draft (pre-implementation, NOT yet frozen). The durable, DAG-node-shaped unit of work the cascade classifier emits and the executor drains. Carried as the payload of a task_proposed / task_updated session event (see docs/architecture/task_record.md). Source: docs/architecture/cascade_classifier.md.

id.description: Session-unique task identifier. Stable across the record's lifecycle; the DAG node key that deps reference.

goal.description: The extracted objective in natural language, e.g. 'write the Temporal design doc to docs/architecture/task_management_with_temporal_io.md'.

type.description: artifact = produce/write content; command = execute a tool/shell action; query = read-only retrieval/answer. Drives which executor path and which command-policy gate applies.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Append-only: each transition is a new task_updated event; the current state is the latest event for this id. See the state machine in task_record.md.

stakes.description: high for destructive/irreversible actions (file write, command exec) — these always escalate to a classifier vote and may require command-policy confirmation.

params.description: Type-specific parameters. artifact: { path, content_ref | content }. command: { argv | command }. query: { target }. Shape is validated by the executor per type, not here.

deps.description: Ids of tasks that must reach 'done' before this one is 'ready'. Empty for a standalone task (Family A). A populated deps set is a DAG edge list — the Family-B seam, same schema.

provenance.description: How this task was classified — the audit trail, answerable from the event log.

source.description: turn = the user asked for it; response = the model produced/committed to it (verifier/critic path); reconciler = derived by folding both.

escalated.description: Whether classification went past the Tier-1 coarse gate into a Tier-2 self-consistency vote.

confidence.description: Measured confidence: for an escalated task, the vote's agreement share; otherwise the coarse gate's self-report.

vote_spread.description: Verdict -> count from the Tier-2 fold (fanout.Decision.Spread), present when escalated.

model.description: The (single) model that produced the classification.

verification.description: Set by the executor after acting, before the surface may report success. Closes the phantom-success loop: 'done' requires verified=true.

verified.description: Whether the action's effect was observed (file exists, command exited 0, etc.).

checked_epoch.description: Millisecond epoch when the effect was verified.

result_ref.description: Ordinal or id of the tool_result event this task produced, linking the record to its outcome in the event log.

created_epoch.description: Millisecond epoch when the task was first proposed.

updated_epoch.description: Millisecond epoch of the latest status transition.
